title: Nicodemus by Night
setting: Jerusalem, at night, during the Passover
scene: Jerusalem during the Passover, early in Jesus's ministry. He has just driven the merchants out of the temple and done signs in the city, and many have believed. Nicodemus, a Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews, a member of the council, has come to him by night, so as not to be seen, to find out what he is. Only the two of them are present.
